tools.description: Check the SoloMotion link: whether a tab is connected, and every agent session's bridge on it (version, PID, stale copies). When no tab is linked, tell the user: open SoloMotion (https://open.solomotion.app or the desktop app), then Agents ▸ Use your agent app ▸ Link.

takeOver.description: Only when the user wants THIS session to hold the link (or a call said the hub is too old): moves the link and the hub here at once and reports what it took over. A bridge before 3.8 cannot hand over, so its process is stopped.

instructions: SoloMotion is a motion design and video studio. Read solomotion://skill/SKILL.md first — it is how to work in the app — and its references only when a task touches them. The skill's `version` changes when the app teaches something new; if you remember an older one, re-read. Every change you make is visible live to the user and is one undo step per request.
